At the center of the Dublin Veterans Memorial Auditorium. The fun/frolic is available for children entering through Hilderbrand Park.
There is at 6 p.m. on Monday at the Village Green in Historic Dublin, and a Concert on the Green at 7 p.m. at the Sycamore Park Amphitheater, located at the intersection of North High Street and River Road. Open to the public for free, it will feature local, regional, and national performing artists along with the cities of Dublin and Worthington.
Fireworks start at 10 p.m. at the Sycamore Park Amphitheater. The fireworks align with sound from the country and big-band radio station Q106 (and can be heard at 105.7 FM, Q105.7 FM and Q106.com online) from the west side podium.
There’s no better place to celebrate July Fourth than at Powell’s Freedom Fest 2016 on Friday, with more events throughout the week and fireworks on Saturday night. From the city’s official Web site, here are event tips and wrinkles …
